data.content_ref: inline:The adversarial persona approach (SRC_004) is compatible with the necessity of separate engines (SRC_003) if the persona shift is viewed not as a replacement for separate weights, but as a method to approximate the statistical orthogonality typically provided by a different model architecture; this is refuted if the persona shift fails to break the covariance of errors in more than 50% of systemic hallucination cases.
